name: lifeflow-root
description: LifeFlow Blood Network Platform Root Proxy

scripts.build: npm --prefix Site install && npm --prefix Site run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('Site/dist')){fs.cpSync('Site/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true, force: true});}"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler deploy
